---
name: "\U0001F4DA Documentation request"
about: Request or report an issue with documentation
title: "[Docs] "
labels: ["documentation"]
assignees: ""
---

**Documentation affected**

Which document(s) is this about? E.g. `README.md`, `docs/API_Documentation.md`,
`docs/System_Architecture.md`, a docstring, etc.

**What is missing / incorrect**

A clear description of the gap, error, or inconsistency you found.

**Suggested change / expected content**

If you have a suggestion, describe the content that should appear so readers
benefit (include code samples, endpoint fields, diagrams, etc. where relevant).

**Context / why it matters**

Why is this documentation important to you and other users? (e.g. onboarding,
API consumers, deployment.)

**Additional notes**

Any other context, links, or references.
